heroText: A global family united in faith — praying for one another, fellowshipping together, and spreading the Good News of our Lord Jesus Christ.
welcome:
Welcome to God Is Able International Prayer Ministries, where men and women have dedicated their lives to serving our Lord Jesus Christ and living according to His teachings. The brothers and sisters of GIA are on a mission to spread the Good News of Our Lord Jesus Christ, to fellowship with one another, and to pray for one another.

With members in Germany, Nigeria, Cameroon, USA, Canada, UK, and beyond, the community of GIA is a global family united in faith. We extend an open invitation to all who seek spiritual connection and support. Whether you're in need of prayer, fellowship, or simply seeking a sense of belonging, we welcome you with open arms.
featureText: Equipping children, building brighter futures. We provide backpacks, notebooks, pencils and school supplies to children in Cameroon as they prepare for the new school year. Nothing is too small — every gift makes a difference.
